text: Between steps 750 and 3000 at e <= 0.85, val_mse_ratio falls about 10x while raw accel_step R2 gains only about 0.05. On the same checkpoints, does a linear probe on log(accel_step), or a small MLP probe, gain substantially more R2 over training? That would show whether the extra next-step accuracy goes into a nonlinear (pericentre-tail) part of the acceleration code that a linear probe cannot read.
